Notes: IRID011 and IRID038 were excluded (no HTLV-1 clones detected)

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ineq, tidyplots,datatable)

gini_index <- function(counts) {
  n <- length(counts)
  mean_count <- mean(counts)
  sum_abs_diff <- sum(sapply(counts, function(x) sum(abs(x - counts))))
  gini <- sum_abs_diff / (2 * n^2 * mean_count)
  return(gini)
}

htlv_is = read_tsv("concatenated_clonality.txt", col_names = c("range", "chrom", "start", "end", "freq", "freq_p", "sample"))
htlv_is
# Option A for gini index
result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  summarise(gini = Gini(freq), .groups = 'drop') |>
  filter(gini>0.4) # filtering those with high oligoclonality

# Option B
result <- htlv_is |>
  group_by(sample) |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(~ tibble(sample = .x$sample[1], 
    gini = Gini(.x$freq),
    sum_freq = sum(.x$freq))) 

# Plotting
result |>
tidyplot(x=gini, y=sum_freq) |>
add_data_points(alpha=0.8) |>
adjust_x_axis(title = "Oligoclonality Index (OCI)") |>
adjust_y_axis(title = "Integration Sites (IS) \nNGS Abundance") |>
save_plot("output/oci.png", 
  view_plot = TRUE,
  bg = "transparent",
  width = 7,
  height = 7, 
  unit="cm")


datatable(result)
```
